codeReview.summary: The commit correctly restores normal-server startup of the audio transcription runner and mounts HTTP realtime routes, but it does not wire the realtime WebSocket broker into server startup, so the advertised realtime ws path is non-functional.

issues.description: Realtime WebSocket upgrade handling is never initialized. `api/server/services/Realtime/broker.js` defines `initializeRealtimeServer(server)` (line 165), and `api/server/services/Realtime/modelService.js` advertises `wsPath: '/api/realtime/ws'` (line 389), but `api/server/index.js` only mounts `/api/realtime` HTTP routes (line 167) and starts scheduled/transcription runners (lines 210-211). Result: `/api/realtime/models` can succeed while `/api/realtime/ws` has no upgrade broker. Remediation: import `initializeRealtimeServer` from `~/server/services/Realtime/broker`, invoke it after `app.server = app.listen(...)` is established, and add/extend startup tests to assert ws upgrades are handled.
